```sql
-- name: top_products
-- owner: merchandising
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
-- Best sellers by units and revenue. Line items reference the variant by its
-- string id (integration feed), so it is cast when joining the catalog.
WITH line_agg AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           count(DISTINCT o.id)        AS order_count,
           sum(ol.quantity)            AS quantity,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents)    AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT pv.id)       AS variant_count
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY pv.product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       la.order_count,
       la.quantity,
       la.revenue_cents,
       la.variant_count
  FROM line_agg la
  JOIN products p ON p.id = la.product_id
 ORDER BY la.quantity DESC, la.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De aggregatie groepeert nu op `product_id` (één uuid-kolom) vóór de join met `products`, zodat die join alleen op het kleinere aantal productgroepen plaatsvindt. Omdat `products.id` de primary key is en `product_variants.product_id` een verplichte foreign key, verandert de join de rijen en waarden niet. Bij gelijke `quantity` en `revenue_cents` is de volgorde onbepaald, net als in het origineel.
